declared_criterion: Pilot: estimate discrimination; the minimum relevant effect for the final protocol is declared in evidence/wp14/pilot_declaration.md

document_and_numerical_tiers.gabriel: as gabriel_reference_plan with the model planner (one planner request per plan version)
document_and_numerical_tiers.gabriel_all_revisions: as gabriel_reference_plan with the declared all_revisions view: every eligible revision enters the prompt, revocation and authorization still apply (ablation of the revision rule; document tasks only)
document_and_numerical_tiers.gabriel_no_repair: as gabriel with max_repairs=0 and max_plan_versions=1 (ablation of the repair cycle)
document_and_numerical_tiers.gabriel_plain_sources: as gabriel_reference_plan with the declared plain view: every declared source file enters the prompt regardless of revision or revocation (ablation of provenance-aware retrieval; document tasks only)
document_and_numerical_tiers.gabriel_reference_plan: run state succeeded with the pack's reference plan and the production retrieval view (effective revision, authorized and available sources; contained numerical worker)
document_and_numerical_tiers.provider_only: an admissible deliverable was produced (amendment applied or declared operation executed through the same adapter); no verification
document_and_numerical_tiers.simple_loop: the system's own run of the independent content checks passed (plain source view, no owner, memory service or policy)

declared_success.gabriel: run state succeeded (every mandatory check passed with eligible evidence, artifacts verified, effects reconciled)
declared_success.gabriel_episodes: as gabriel_reference_plan (rule-based repair) with the frozen episodes retrievable into the worker prompt (readout ablation)
declared_success.gabriel_no_repair: as gabriel, with max_repairs=0 and max_plan_versions=1 (ablation of the repair cycle)
declared_success.gabriel_policy: as gabriel_reference_plan, with the frozen readout policy pinned: at a failed verification it chooses repair or stop from the progress channels, and it may retrieve frozen episodes into the worker prompt
declared_success.gabriel_reference_plan: as gabriel, with the domain pack's deterministic reference plan admitted without a planner request (planner ablation)
declared_success.provider_only: an admissible patch was applied (no verification)
declared_success.simple_loop: the system's own runs of the visible tests and the oracle both exited 0

metrics: model requests, model tokens and wall time per run
recovery: Gabriel runs that used repair cycles or extra plan versions
paired differences gabriel - baseline per task (mean over repetitions)
bootstrap percentile intervals, resampling task families with replacement (and tasks as a secondary view)
note: Protocol 5 pilot (not the final protocol): revision, revoked, units and resample families once per unit; conflict and graph are never run before the final protocol. Declaration of the minimum relevant effect: evidence/wp14/pilot_declaration.md, written before this freeze.
purpose: Matched comparison: increase independently verified task success or reduce resources at equal success, under a fixed task distribution and matched constraints. Not a benchmark of general capability.
sample_size_statement: 12 tasks in 4 families; the minimum relevant effect is not predeclared from a pilot, so intervals are reported as descriptive uncertainty, not as a powered test
verification: fresh, system-independent: changed paths within allowed_paths; visible tests exit 0; oracle installed from the corpus text and exit 0; all executed in the containment backend on the final tree
